+    assert len(taken_by_deregister) == 1, "window not deregistered exactly once"
+    assert free_with_view - free_with_pool < scratch_bytes, "freed under a live view"
+    freed = free_released - free_with_view + taken_by_deregister[0]
+    assert freed >= scratch_bytes, "window buffer leaked"
+
+
+def _run_cross_node_mla(rank, world, port):
+    with unittest.mock.patch(
+        "sglang.srt.mem_cache.page_interleave_pool.in_the_same_node_as",
+        lambda pg, source_rank: [r == source_rank for r in range(world)],
+    ):
+        pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len = _run_mla(rank, world, port)
+    assert not pool._use_symmetric_scratch and not pool._scratch_window_registered
+    activity = _gather_gpu_activity(pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len)
+    assert any("nccl" in name.lower() for name in activity)
+
+
+def _run_zero_sm_allgather_comparison(rank, world, init_method):
+    """Compare the pool's in-place window contract with ordinary NCCL."""
+    torch.cuda.set_device(rank)
+    torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+        backend="gloo", rank=rank, world_size=world, init_method=init_method
+    )
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    group = torch.distributed.group.WORLD
+    zero_sm = PyNcclCommunicator(group, device, cta_policy=NCCL_CTA_POLICY_ZERO)
+    ordinary = PyNcclCommunicator(group, device)
+    assert zero_sm.available and ordinary.available
+    max_send_bytes = 1 << 20
+
+    for dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+        # Both alternating slots start inside the window, rather than at its
+        # base. The input is each rank's slice of the registered receive view,
+        # exactly as in _prefetch_layer; its offset also changes with payload.
+        offsets, nbytes = _symmetric_scratch_layout(
+            {
+                "padding": ((4096,), torch.uint8),
+                "output": ((world * max_send_bytes // dtype.itemsize,), dtype),
+            },
+            num_slots=2,
+        )
+        buffer, registered = allocate_symmetric_buffer(zero_sm, nbytes)
+        assert registered, "comparison requires a real symmetric window"
+        slots = [
+            buffer[slot["output"] : slot["output"] + world * max_send_bytes].view(dtype)
+            for slot in offsets
+        ]
+        assert all(slot["output"] > 0 for slot in offsets)
+
+        def compare(slot_index, send_bytes, generation, graph=None):
+            count = send_bytes // dtype.itemsize
+            output = slots[slot_index][: world * count]
+            send = output[rank * count : (rank + 1) * count]
+            output.zero_()
+            values = (
+                (torch.arange(count, device=device, dtype=torch.int32) * 17)
+                + rank * 29
+                + generation * 31
+            ) % 251
+            send.copy_(values)
+            reference_input = send.clone()
+            reference = torch.empty_like(output)
+            if graph is None:
+                with zero_sm.change_state(enable=True):
+                    zero_sm.all_gather(output, send)
+            else:
+                graph.replay()
+            # Use the same loaded NCCL library for the ordinary baseline,
+            # with torch allocations and the default communicator policy.
+            with ordinary.change_state(enable=True):
+                ordinary.all_gather(reference, reference_input)
+            _assert_bytes(
+                output,
+                reference,
+                f"rank {rank}, {dtype}, {send_bytes} B, generation {generation}",
+            )
+
+        for send_bytes in (256, 16 << 10, max_send_bytes):
+            for generation in range(6):
+                compare(generation % 2, send_bytes, generation)
+
+        # Profile only the CE call: the ordinary baseline deliberately issues
+        # an NCCL kernel and must not contaminate the zero-SM assertion.
+        output = slots[1]
+        count = max_send_bytes // dtype.itemsize
+        send = output[rank * count : (rank + 1) * count]
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        with torch.profiler.profile(
+            activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]
+        ) as prof:
+            with zero_sm.change_state(enable=True):
+                zero_sm.all_gather(output, send)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        activity = [
+            event.name
+            for event in prof.events()
+            if event.device_type == torch.autograd.DeviceType.CUDA
+        ]
+        assert not any("nccl" in name.lower() for name in activity), activity
+        assert any("PtoP" in name for name in activity), activity
+
+        # Replay the same registered addresses with fresh contributions. A
+        # comparison only at capture time would miss stale peer data on replay.
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            with zero_sm.change_state(enable=True):
+                zero_sm.all_gather(output, send)
+        for generation in (7, 8, 9):
+            compare(1, max_send_bytes, generation, graph=graph)
+        del graph, send, output
+        slots.clear()
+        del buffer
+        gc.collect()
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(
+    torch.cuda.device_count() < 2, "page-interleave gather needs 2 CUDA devices"
+)

+            tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sglang-zero-sm-gather-") as tmp,

+"""Greedy logprob parity for Inkling: unified tri-pool vs static pools.
+
+Not registered in CI: it boots two servers back to back. The tri-pool guards
+that run per commit live in test/registered/e2e/models/test_inkling_unified.py,
+which this file imports its server args and prompts from.
+
+Run: python3 test/manual/models/test_inkling_unified_parity.py
+"""
+
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+sys.path.insert(
+    0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "registered" / "e2e" / "models")
+)
+from test_inkling_unified import (  # noqa: E402
+    _MODEL_PATH,
+    _MODEL_REVISION,
+    _PARITY_PROMPTS,
+    _greedy_generate,
+    _unified_args,
+)
+
+
+def _static_args():
+    args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "triton",
+        "--page-size",
+        "128",
+        "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy",
+        "extra_buffer",
+        # Match the unified cell's Triton pin, which cannot serve Inkling's
+        # default FULL prefill graph.
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "disabled",
+        "--swa-full-tokens-ratio",
+        "0.1",
+        "--mamba-full-memory-ratio",
+        "0.1",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.5",
+    ]
+    if _MODEL_REVISION:
+        args += ["--revision", _MODEL_REVISION]
+    return args
+
+
+class TestInklingUnifiedVsStaticParity(CustomTestCase):
+    """Greedy logprob parity: unified tri-pool vs static pools, same prompts.
+    Two sequential boots -- the strongest wrong-slot tripwire short of GSM8K."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _collect(cls, other_args):
+        proc = popen_launch_server(
+            _MODEL_PATH,
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=other_args,
+        )
+        try:
+            out = []
+            for p in _PARITY_PROMPTS:
+                data = _greedy_generate(
+                    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, p, max_new_tokens=32, logprobs=True
+                )
+                out.append(
+                    (
+                        data["text"],
+                        [t[0] for t in data["meta_info"]["output_token_logprobs"]],
+                    )
+                )
+            return out
+        finally:
+            kill_process_tree(proc.pid)
+
+    def test_parity(self):
+        static = self._collect(_static_args())
+        unified = self._collect(_unified_args())
+        for (s_text, s_lp), (u_text, u_lp) in zip(static, unified):
+            self.assertEqual(s_text, u_text)
+            for a, b in zip(s_lp, u_lp):
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(a, b, places=2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash Python chat templates against the checkpoints' Jinja.
+
+Set SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_CHECKPOINT / SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_FLASH_CHECKPOINT to model
+directories holding chat_template.jinja and the tokenizer, then run:
+    python3 test/manual/parser/test_glm53_checkpoint_template.py
+"""
+
+import os
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+from transformers.utils.chat_template_utils import _compile_jinja_template
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.parallel_prompt_encode import encode_prompt_segments
+from sglang.srt.parser.glm53_chat_template import render_glm53, render_glm53_flash
+from sglang.srt.parser.python_chat_template import (
+    GLM53,
+    GLM53_FLASH,
+    render_chat_segments,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+sys.path.insert(
+    0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "registered" / "unit" / "parser")
+)
+from test_glm53_chat_template import CASES, _render  # noqa: E402
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_CHECKPOINT")
+    or os.environ.get("SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_FLASH_CHECKPOINT"),
+    "set SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_CHECKPOINT / SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_FLASH_CHECKPOINT",
+)
+class TestAgainstCheckpointTemplates(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_matches_checkpoint_jinja(self):
+        for env, render, template in (
+            ("SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_CHECKPOINT", render_glm53, GLM53),
+            ("SGLANG_TEST_GLM53_FLASH_CHECKPOINT", render_glm53_flash, GLM53_FLASH),
+        ):
+            model_dir = os.environ.get(env)
+            if not model_dir:
+                continue
+            with open(
+                os.path.join(model_dir, "chat_template.jinja"), encoding="utf-8"
+            ) as f:
+                compiled = _compile_jinja_template(f.read())
+            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_dir)
+            for name, (kwargs, _, _) in CASES.items():
+                for add_generation_prompt in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        model=model_dir, case=name, gen=add_generation_prompt
+                    ):
+                        kwargs = {
+                            **kwargs,
+                            "add_generation_prompt": add_generation_prompt,
+                        }
+                        prompt = compiled.render(**kwargs)
+                        self.assertEqual(_render(render, kwargs), prompt)
+                        variables = dict(kwargs)
+                        segments = render_chat_segments(
+                            tokenizer,
+                            template,
+                            variables.pop("messages"),
+                            tools=variables.pop("tools", None),
+                            add_generation_prompt=variables.pop(
+                                "add_generation_prompt"
+                            ),
+                            template_kwargs=variables,
+                        )
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            encode_prompt_segments(tokenizer, segments),
+                            tokenizer.encode(prompt),
+                        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""``diffusion.aten_head_rmsnorm``: the bit-exact replica of ROCm aten ``rms_norm``.
+
+ROCm-only: the oracle is ROCm's own ``F.rms_norm`` (and the bf16 NeoX
+``rotary_embedding`` that follows it), so these cases run on the AMD lane and
+nothing in ``test_norm.py`` does.
+"""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=10, stage="jit-kernel-unit", runner_config="amd")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.version.hip is None,
+    reason="replays ROCm aten rms_norm",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(8256, 56), (37, 14), (2, 9, 3)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("varying_exponent", [False, True])
+def test_aten_head_rmsnorm_matches_rocm_rms_norm(shape, varying_exponent):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
+        aten_head_rmsnorm,
+        can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm,
+    )
+
+    *tokens, heads = shape
+    # q of a fused qkv projection: a strided view with packed heads
+    qkv = torch.randn(*tokens, 3 * heads * 128, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    if varying_exponent:
+        exponents = torch.randint(-12, 12, qkv.shape, device=DEVICE).float()
+        qkv = (qkv.float() * torch.exp2(exponents)).to(qkv.dtype)
+    q = qkv[..., : heads * 128].unflatten(-1, (heads, 128))
+    weight = torch.randn(128, device=DEVICE, dtype=q.dtype)
+    assert can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm(q, weight)
+    out = aten_head_rmsnorm(q, weight, 1e-6)
+    assert out.is_contiguous()
+    assert torch.equal(out, F.rms_norm(q, (128,), weight, 1e-6))
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rot_dim", [96, 128, 64])
+def test_aten_head_rmsnorm_rope_matches_rms_norm_then_rotary_embedding(rot_dim):
+    from sgl_kernel import rotary_embedding
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
+        aten_head_rmsnorm,
+        can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm_rope,
+    )
+
+    tokens, heads = 1031, 14
+    qkv = torch.randn(tokens, 3 * heads * 128, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    q = qkv[:, : heads * 128].view(tokens, heads, 128)
+    weight = torch.randn(128, device=DEVICE, dtype=q.dtype)
+    angles = torch.rand(2 * tokens, rot_dim // 2, device=DEVICE) * 100
+    cache = torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1).to(q.dtype)
+    positions = torch.randperm(2 * tokens, device=DEVICE)[:tokens]
+    assert can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm_rope(q, cache, positions)
+    expected = F.rms_norm(q, (128,), weight, 1e-5)
+    key = expected.clone()
+    rotary_embedding(
+        positions, expected.view(tokens, -1), key.view(tokens, -1), 128, cache, True
+    )
+    out = aten_head_rmsnorm(q, weight, 1e-5, cache, positions)
+    assert torch.equal(out, expected)
+
+
+def test_aten_head_rmsnorm_guards():
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm
+
+    x = torch.ones(4, 3, 128, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    weight = torch.ones(128, device=DEVICE, dtype=x.dtype)
+    for inputs, gamma in [
+        (x.float(), weight.float()),
+        (x, weight.float()),
+        (x, None),
+        (x.transpose(0, 1), weight),
+        (x[..., ::2], weight[::2]),
+        (x.flatten(0, 1), weight),
+        (x[:0], weight),
+        (x.cpu(), weight.cpu()),
+    ]:
+        assert not can_use_aten_head_rmsnorm(inputs, gamma)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

+"""SM120-only model fast paths split out of ``test_model_fast_paths.py``.
+
+SANA-Video's depthwise GLU and Joy's image MLP epilogue are enabled on SM120
+only, so they run on the RTX 5090 lane; the other model wrappers run on H100.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+import sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.sana as sana
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.sites.bitexact_gate import BitExactFusionGate
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    model_parallel_is_initialized,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.test.single_test_file.component_accuracy.utils import (
+    ensure_distributed_env_defaults,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available()
+    or torch.version.hip is not None
+    or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (12, 0),
+    reason="these fast paths are enabled on SM120 only",
+)
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# SANA-Video -- depthwise convolution and rounded GLU
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(2, 34, 1, 1), (2, 192, 7, 11), (21, 13440, 30, 52)])
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_glu_rounding_and_row_tails(shape):
+    """Keep each BF16 rounding boundary and mask partial four-row tiles."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu
+
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    x = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(
+        memory_format=torch.channels_last
+    )
+    weight = torch.randn((shape[1], 1, 3, 3), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype) * 0.1
+    bias = torch.randn(shape[1], device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype) * 0.1
+    raw = F.conv2d(x, weight, None, padding=1, groups=shape[1])
+    hidden, gate = (raw + bias[None, :, None, None]).chunk(2, dim=1)
+    actual = fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu(x, weight, bias)
+    assert torch.equal(actual, hidden * F.silu(gate))
+    assert actual.is_contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_gate_capture_and_changed_inputs(monkeypatch):
+    """Capture cannot verify; warmed replay must read current inputs and bias."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import sana_video
+
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test depthwise", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    module = sana_video.GLUMBTempConv(32, 3).cuda().bfloat16()
+    module.conv_depth = (
+        nn.Conv2d(13440, 13440, 3, padding=1, groups=13440).cuda().bfloat16()
+    )
+    x = torch.randn((2, 13440, 30, 52), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(
+        memory_format=torch.channels_last
+    )
+    expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        unverified = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert torch.equal(unverified, expected)
+    assert not gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+    assert torch.equal(module._depthwise_glu(x), expected)
+    assert gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        actual = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+    x.add_(0.125)
+    module.conv_depth.bias.mul_(0.75)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert torch.equal(
+        actual, sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    )
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test mismatch", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    with monkeypatch.context() as context:
+        context.setattr(
+            sana_video,
+            "fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu",
+            lambda *args: torch.zeros_like(expected),
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(module._depthwise_glu(x), expected)
+    assert gate.disabled
+    x.mul_(0.5)
+    assert torch.equal(
+        module._depthwise_glu(x),
+        sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("grad_enabled", [True, False])
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_reference_fallback(monkeypatch, grad_enabled):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import sana_video
+
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test fallback", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    module = sana_video.GLUMBTempConv(32, 3).cuda().bfloat16()
+    # Both shapes pass the size floor. Use two groups for the non-cuDNN path.
+    shape = (2, 13440, 30, 52) if grad_enabled else (1, 2, 4096, 2048)
+    module.conv_depth = (
+        nn.Conv2d(shape[1], shape[1], 3, padding=1, groups=shape[1]).cuda().bfloat16()
+    )
+    x = (
+        torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        .to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
+        .requires_grad_(grad_enabled)
+    )
+    with (
+        torch.set_grad_enabled(grad_enabled),
+        torch.backends.cudnn.flags(enabled=grad_enabled),
+    ):
+        actual = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+        expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+        assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
+        if grad_enabled:
+            actual_grad = torch.autograd.grad(actual.sum(), x)[0]
+            expected_grad = torch.autograd.grad(expected.sum(), x)[0]
+            assert torch.equal(actual_grad, expected_grad)
+    assert not gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Joy -- high-mode image MLP epilogue on SM120
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_joy_image_mlp_quality_restore_and_dynamic_lora():
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.lora.linear import wrap_with_lora_layer
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.mlp import MLP
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import joy_image
+
+    if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        ensure_distributed_env_defaults()
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(tp_size=1, sp_size=1)
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    mlp = MLP(4096, 16384).to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    for parameter in mlp.parameters():
+        parameter.normal_(0, 0.01)
+    x = torch.randn(1, 7168, 4096, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    reference = mlp(x)
+    with patch.object(
+        joy_image, "fused_linear_gelu_tanh", wraps=joy_image.fused_linear_gelu_tanh
+    ) as fused:
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            joy_image._joy_image_mlp(mlp, x, fuse_gelu=True),
+            reference,
+            atol=2e-2,
+            rtol=2e-2,
+        )
+        assert fused.call_count == 1
+        assert torch.equal(joy_image._joy_image_mlp(mlp, x, fuse_gelu=False), reference)
+        # Smaller text/token counts must keep their original, faster projection.

+    """Each token's (n, k) id: the windowed modular hash of the n tokens ending at

+                    token_ids.append(acc % mod + sums[n * ne_k + k])

+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+from sglang.utils import TypeBasedDispatcher
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class Base:
+    pass
+
+
+class Child(Base):
+    pass
+
+
+class GrandChild(Child):
+    pass
+
+
+class Unknown:
+    pass
+
+
+class TestTypeBasedDispatcher(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_exact_type_then_first_registered_base(self):
+        dispatcher = TypeBasedDispatcher(
+            [(Base, lambda _: "base"), (Child, lambda _: "child")]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(Child()), "child")
+        # No exact match: registration order decides, not MRO distance; the
+        # second call is served from the MRO cache.
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(GrandChild()), "base")
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(GrandChild()), "base")
+
+    def test_unknown_type_raises_until_fallback_is_set(self):
+        dispatcher = TypeBasedDispatcher([(Base, lambda _: "base")])
+        for _ in range(2):
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                dispatcher(Unknown())
+        dispatcher.add_fallback_fn(lambda _: "fallback")
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(Unknown()), "fallback")
+
+    def test_iadd_keeps_existing_handlers(self):
+        dispatcher = TypeBasedDispatcher([(Base, lambda _: "first")])
+        dispatcher += TypeBasedDispatcher(
+            [(Base, lambda _: "second"), (Unknown, lambda _: "unknown")]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(Base()), "first")
+        self.assertEqual(dispatcher(Unknown()), "unknown")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
